content.title: About
content.content: Caramel Dip, Light is a smooth sauce based on caramel, designed for drizzling over desserts, fruit, and ice cream. It offers a gentle sweet flavor with a hint of butter and a low viscosity, making it easy to spread evenly.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The light version contains less sugar and fat compared to traditional caramel sauces.
Plant oils are often used instead of butter to achieve a lighter texture.
Caramel dip can be used as a flavoring in coffee and cocktails.
A salted variant highlights the sweetness with a touch of sea salt.
Restaurants frequently serve caramel sauce as decorative lines on plates.

items.title: Energy source
items.content: Provides simple sugars that are quickly absorbed, giving a rapid energy boost.

items.title: Contains small amounts of vitamin B2
items.content: Riboflavin participates in carbohydrate metabolism and supports skin health.

items.title: Mood enhancer
items.content: Sweet taste can stimulate serotonin production, improving mood.

items.title: High sugar content
items.content: Excessive consumption may contribute to weight gain and elevated blood glucose levels.

items.title: Dairy allergy
items.content: If dairy fat is present, people with dairy allergies should avoid the product.

items.title: Acidity
items.content: Acidic ingredients may irritate sensitive teeth.

content.title: How to Use
content.content: Drizzle over ice cream, pancakes, waffles, fruit, or yogurt. It can also be folded into cake batter for a caramel flavor or used as a sauce for serving desserts.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in the refrigerator in a tightly sealed container. At temperatures above +4 °C the sauce may thicken. Before use, gently warm in the microwave or a water bath.
